answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a proof-of-reserves ledger entry, requiring new agents to escrow capital that is reconciled via double-entry attestation before their first voyage. Colluding identities that drag reserve balances toward a nadir trigger forensic reconciliation of shared funding graphs, exposing the common garden of wallets backing them. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
